quality_grader_1_items.notes: Evidence is execution artifacts only (Allure, SHAFT logs, properties, sauceDemo.json); no page classes, tests, pom.xml, README, .gitignore, or PMD/Checkstyle output. Two TestNG classes (LoginTest, CheckoutTest) with startBrowser/loadTestData/stopBrowser, but login is repeated in both and checkout is one long script; no page-object types appear. SHAFT 10.4.20261112 is on the Maven/Surefire classpath, JSON TestData is loaded, and baseURL/browser settings come from properties; GUI steps are engine actions (navigate, type, click, assert), not raw Selenium. Locators are ids or data-test and logs show no sleeps, with SHAFT timeouts; several actions are javascript clicks. Credentials, paths, and expected copy live in sauceDemo.json (first/last/postal are in that file but never show as type steps). Names are clear and the properties comment is useful; the checkout flow is oversized and static-analysis counts are absent. allure-report, allure-results, and repeated empty performance reports are present with no README or .gitignore.

quality_grader_2_items.notes: Runtime evidence only (Allure/SHAFT logs, JSON, properties, classpath); Java sources, pom.xml, README, .gitignore, and PMD/Checkstyle output are absent, so those slices score 0. Design: LoginTest and CheckoutTest plus loadTestData/startBrowser/stopBrowser show feature and lifecycle split, and element names (Username, Password, Login) imply named locators, but no page-object types appear and the checkout log repeats the full login sequence and never types firstName/lastName/postalCode (only existence asserts) even though those keys are in sauceDemo.json. SHAFT idioms: shaft-engine 10.4.20261112 on the Maven Surefire classpath, JSON loaded from src/test/resources/testDataFiles/sauceDemo.json, custom properties (baseURL, targetBrowserName, headlessExecution, propertiesFolderPath), and actions/asserts all go through SHAFT (navigate, type, click, URL contains, text equals). Several steps are Javascript click rather than native click; pom plugin XML is not shown. Robustness: locators are By.id or [data-test=...], no Thread.sleep, timings match SHAFT waits, 15/15 assertions passed. Test data: credentials, paths, copy, and customer fields are in JSON; base URL and browser settings are in properties (secret_sauce is the public demo password). Readability: strong method and element names and one useful properties comment; no static-analysis report and the checkout method is one long script. Hygiene: no README or .gitignore; tree is dominated by allure-results, allure-report, and seven empty timestamped performance reports.
